authoring.value:
With constant acceleration, the position is

$$
\mathbf r(t)=\mathbf r_0+\mathbf u t+\tfrac12\mathbf a t^2.
$$

Here $\mathbf r_0=\mathbf0$, $\mathbf u=2\mathbf i\,\mathrm{m/s}$, and $\mathbf a=(3\mathbf i-4\mathbf j)\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$. At $t=4\,\mathrm{s}$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathbf r(4)&=\mathbf0+(2\mathbf i)(4)+\tfrac12(3\mathbf i-4\mathbf j)(4^2)\\
&=8\mathbf i+24\mathbf i-32\mathbf j\\
&=(32\mathbf i-32\mathbf j)\,\mathrm m.
\end{aligned}
$$

The distance to the origin is therefore

$$
|\mathbf r(4)|=\sqrt{32^2+(-32)^2}=\sqrt{2048}=\boxed{32\sqrt2\,\mathrm m}.
$$
